references.name: Reinforcement Learning Locomotion
references.evidence: Clumsy, awkward walking gaits of low-poly humanoids and animals characteristic of AI agents learning locomotion in a physics engine.

references.name: MuJoCo
references.evidence: The minimalist sky and ground background, flat lighting, and joint-based character structures match standard OpenAI Gym and MuJoCo simulation environments.

result.one_line: A compilation of clumsy and derpy 3D physics-based reinforcement learning agents attempting to walk.
